long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Fez and trained as a civil engineer, Attias began his career in technology before moving into communications and live-event production. He spent a decade at Publicis, ultimately chairing its worldwide events business, and produced major international forums. That combination of technical training, network building and large-scale delivery became the foundation of his entrepreneurial work.

Attias founded Richard Attias & Associates in 2008 as a strategic communications and advisory firm. The company builds forums, live experiences and brand programmes for corporate and institutional clients, with teams across several international cities. He remains founder and chairman, while his work has expanded from event production into broader advisory, content and partnership development. Outside the company, he has continued leading global convening platforms focused on investment and innovation.
